record.title: Open time and total assembly time differ
record.scope: Titebond III at 70 F and 50% RH
facts: The product page lists an application temperature above 47 F, while its limitations mention above 45 F.
required: Confirm the product and actual temperature/humidity; plan the dry fit first.
limits: These are assembly windows, not clamp-release or service-cure times.
conflicts: 47 F versus 45 F needs manufacturer clarification; do not issue a universal minimum.

products: Titebond III at 70 F and 50% RH
jurisdiction: Manufacturer/authority scope as cited; verify local requirements
exclusions: These are assembly windows, not clamp-release or service-cure times.

evidence.support: Two sections state different minimum temperatures.
